reauth_confirm.description: GitHub rejected the existing credential. Enter a replacement token. Enhanced billing usage requires a personal access token (classic); fine-grained PATs can continue to provide non-billing data.

data_description.auto_discover: Keep repository discovery synchronized within the configured safety cap
data_description.enabled_categories: Optional categories are capability-gated and continue independently when another category fails
data_description.include_archived: Collect archived repositories when they pass selection filters
data_description.include_forks: Collect forked repositories when they pass selection filters
data_description.max_repositories: Maximum repositories collected per refresh, from 1 to 50

scope.description: Authenticated as {account}. GitHub reported {repository_count} accessible repositories.

data_description.billing_token: Optional personal access token (classic), used only for billing and usage endpoints
data_description.server: Use GitHub.com or the HTTPS origin of GitHub Enterprise Server
data_description.token: Stored only in the Home Assistant config entry

user.description: The primary access token is used for account, repository, workflow, security, rate-limit, and Copilot activity APIs. [Create a fine-grained PAT]({fine_grained_pat_url}). The optional classic token is isolated to billing and usage APIs; [create a classic PAT]({classic_pat_url}) only when you need those capabilities.

init.description: Need a value? [Create a classic billing token]({classic_pat_url}) or review [billing usage and organization access]({billing_usage_url}). The enterprise slug is the `<slug>` URL segment in `{enterprise_url_example}`; [learn about enterprise slugs]({enterprise_slug_url}). Personal users normally leave it blank. Enter Actions included minutes only from your known plan/account allowance; [check GitHub's included usage table]({actions_allowance_url}). Copilot activity uses the primary token; review [personal Copilot settings]({copilot_settings_url}) and [organization Copilot policies]({copilot_organization_url}).

data_description.billing_enterprise: Optional GitHub Enterprise Cloud slug described in the guidance above. Personal users normally leave this blank. Enhanced billing is not available on GitHub Enterprise Server.
data_description.billing_interval: Minutes between billing refreshes. GitHub billing data can lag.
data_description.billing_organizations: Organizations whose enhanced-billing data should be requested. Select only organizations where you have an owner or billing-manager role.
data_description.billing_token: Optional personal access token (classic), used only for billing and usage endpoints. When configured, leave the masked value unchanged to keep it; clear the field to remove it.
data_description.budget_management: Disabled by default. Every financial mutation also requires an exact action-specific confirmation through a GitHub Insights service.
data_description.estimated_minutes: Local estimate input only; it never changes GitHub usage or budgets.
data_description.actions_included_minutes: Optional local allowance used to derive configured minutes used, remaining, and percent from GitHub-reported minute quantities. Use 0 to leave unset.
data_description.personal_billing: Requires the optional Billing / Usage API token. Fine-grained PATs are not supported by GitHub billing usage endpoints.
data_description.reference_runner: Price reference used only for clearly labeled estimates.
data_description.enabled_categories: Copilot activity uses the primary token; AI-credit and premium-request billing require the optional classic billing token and an authorized billing role
data_description.max_repositories: Maximum repositories collected per refresh, from 1 to 50
data_description.update_interval: Minutes between account and repository discovery refreshes

capability_unavailable.title: GitHub capability is unavailable
capability_unavailable.description: The {capability} capability is unavailable because of {reason}. Other GitHub Insights data continues updating.

billing_unavailable.title: GitHub billing data is partially unavailable
billing_unavailable.description: Billing data is unavailable because of {reason}. Account and repository data continues updating. GitHub billing usage requires a personal access token (classic).

configured_actions_allowance_unavailable.title: Configured Actions allowance cannot be calculated
configured_actions_allowance_unavailable.description: Configured Actions allowance sensors are unavailable because GitHub reported {reason}. Only unambiguous minute-based gross or discounted/included quantities can be used; net billed quantity is never treated as included-minute consumption.
